hypothesis: The apparent AUD triangular mean reversion is materially concentrated in the New York rollover boundary.
kill_test: The rollover-artifact explanation is weakened if suppressing 16:45-18:00 ET signals leaves the requested 15-minute 30-minute-horizon residual expectancy and signal population materially unchanged.
data_scope: Local AUDUSD, AUDJPY, USDJPY one-minute midpoint OHLC, 2015-01-01 through 2020-12-31; 15-minute primary and 30-minute consistency arm.
primary_metric: Change in 15-minute 30-minute-horizon three-leg residual mean gross/net bp and signal count after the 16:45-18:00 ET blackout.
